No SATISFIED, no Class A, no twelfth class, no G15 ride, no required-now change, no file 08 edit, no implementation authorization, subject unmoved. What defeats it is the residue of the same disease the v3 root cause named: v4 patched the six fields it was told to patch and did not re-walk the strings carried across from v2 and v3. blockers.claim: "A later D-000 recording may pin this v3 occupancy. This file does not edit file 08."
blockers.measurement: Byte-identical carryover from v3, where it was self-consistent. In v4 it is not. proposedLaterWork is the only field in the artifact that tells a later D-000 recording what to pin, and it names v3.
blockers.selfContradiction: Three fields of this same artifact forbid the act this field proposes. doesNot[22]: 'Does not record frozen v3 as a current occupancy remasurement.' basedOn.predecessorV3.role: v3 is 'Not recordable as a current occupancy remasurement.' remeasurementClause: 'Frozen v3 remains a dual-REJECT occupancy.' The governing dispatch adds a fourth: 'Do not record v2 or v3 as a current occupancy remasurement.'
blockers.why: Both available readings fail. Read literally, the field directs the next recording act onto the frozen dual-REJECT v3 — the precise act doesNot[22] and the dispatch prohibit. Read as self-reference, a v4 artifact is calling itself v3 in the one field that governs its own recording, which is the same class of defect as CLAUDE-G31-V3-B2: a carried-forward string whose plain meaning contradicts the artifact's own live pins. This is not cosmetic labelling. v4 exists to be the recordable successor to a rejected v3; the field that says what may be recorded points backward at the rejection.
blockers.provenance: v3.proposedLaterWork equals v4.proposedLaterWork exactly. It was carried, not remeasured. The v3 root cause warned against precisely this: 'The correct repair is a field-by-field remeasurement of every string carried from v2, with the v2-era measurements either updated or explicitly marked historical.' v4 remeasured the six named fields and did not re-walk the rest.
blockers.consequence: A recorder acting on this artifact's own proposedLaterWork would pin v3. That would enter a dual-REJECT specification — one whose passProperty denies a live register row — into the corpus as the current G31 occupancy, and would do so on this file's own instruction while this file's doesNot[22] denies it.
blockers.repair: Rewrite as 'A later D-000 recording may pin this v4 occupancy', or use the artifact-neutral form the sibling entries already use ('This file' / 'This specification'). Then re-walk every remaining string carried from v2 and v3 rather than patching this one entry.

advisories.detail: claimVerbatim is the live file 08 DR-G31 claim cell plus a trailing period the register cell does not carry. One character; every other character matches. Held at advisory, not raised to SHOULD-FIX, because this is the identical unchanged string I graded advisory at v3 as CLAUDE-G31-V3-ADV-1, no meaning turns on the period, and re-grading an unchanged string without new evidence would be arbitrary. Recorded again for two reasons: v4's findingDisposition covers the six blockers and SHOULD-FIXes but silently drops this advisory rather than dispositioning it; and a survey of the corpus shows the house convention is byte fidelity — of 28 harness artifacts carrying claimVerbatim, 26 equal their live file 08 claim cell exactly, and the only two deviations are this G31 lineage and harness.DR-G32.actor-join-fixture-execution.preview.v1. If the corpus ever tightens this field, G31 and G32 are the two rows that will need touching.

I attacked this and it held. The field reads false while D-167's adopted text says 'After this act, D-056 Eligibility gates 2 and 3 hold for DR-104' and the field's own note recites the facts that constitute them (G31 live, leftover-join.v6 leftoverDesign []). That looked like a stale boolean beside a remeasured note. It is not: every harness artifact in the corpus that carries this field records false — 21 of 21, including rows where the gates plainly hold — so the field measures 'this harness specification does not itself make gates 2 and 3 hold', not the gate state of the row. Refuted, and recorded so the next reviewer does not have to re-run it.

rootCause.diagnosis: v4 is a targeted patch, not the field-by-field remeasurement the v3 root cause called for. The six named fields were repaired correctly and completely; nothing else carried from v2 or v3 was re-walked.
rootCause.evidence: A structural diff of v3→v4 shows exactly twelve changed leaves: .artifact, .version, and the six repaired fields plus .authorityClaim, .purpose, .remeasurementClause, and the findingDisposition/predecessorV3/recordedInputs lineage additions. Every other string is byte-identical to v3. A regex sweep of all prose fields for version self-references returns four hits, and all four are stale: predecessorV1.role ('This v2'), namingV2.role ('This v3'), d167.role ('This v3'), proposedLaterWork[1] ('this v3 occupancy'). Three are labelling. The fourth governs the recording act.
rootCause.why_it_matters: The v3 review said the correct repair was to re-walk every carried string, not to fix the three visible faces of one omission. v4 fixed the faces it was pointed at. The omission survived and surfaced in a new place — this time in the field that directs what gets recorded. Patching proposedLaterWork[1] alone would repeat the same mistake a third time. The repair is the sweep: every self-reference and every carried measurement re-read against v4's own identity before the next round.
